_comment: DRAFT (dialogue-drafts lane 2026-07-06, NOT wired). 'Cellar Rights' — the watch-sergeant's side. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-06-home-region-content-2-design.md §2. Voice: the shipped watch_crate.json sergeant (clipped lists, dry, zero ceremony — 'Sewers, scavengers, paperwork. Pick one.'). At wiring time these nodes MERGE INTO data/dialogue/watch_crate.json's hub; drafted standalone for readability. Sibling: cellar_rights_krshia.json. Wiring + opens: cellar_rights.md (shared companion).

hub.speaker: Watch Sergeant
hub.text: The cellar under the row. Cleared, empty, suddenly popular. Krshia wants shelves. I want a seal on it — smuggler holes don't stop being smuggler holes because a Gnoll airs one out.

text_variants.text: Cellar's sealed, lock's Watch-issue, paperwork's filed. Quietest that hole has been in a generation. Good outcome.
Krshia got her cellar. I got a sketch of the wall and a headache that's technically resolved. It keeps flour dry. Fine. FINE.
Shelves below, Watch corner locked, keeper's ledger signed. First dispute this year that ended with both parties still greeting me. Noted for training purposes.

options.text: I've heard Krshia out. There's a middle in this.
The vermin are cleared. I say the Watch takes it.
I read the marks under the dust. Gnollish trade-signs — older than your seal, painted right over them.

case.speaker: Watch Sergeant
case.text: Short version: that hole moved contraband before either of us was posted here. Seal it, log it, done — nobody smuggles through an evidence room. Long version involves forms. Nobody wants the long version.

mediate.speaker: Watch Sergeant
mediate.text: A middle. In my experience the middle is where I stand when two parties start throwing things. Go on. Surprise me.

options.text: Shelves for trade, one locked Watch corner, Krshia signed on as keeper — a keeper is accountable, and accountable beats empty. (Mediate)
Let me think on the terms.

settled_shared.speaker: Watch Sergeant
settled_shared.text: A named keeper, a signed ledger, and a lock I hold the key to. That's not a compromise, that's better paperwork than my first plan. Done. Tell Krshia — she'll want it in writing, and for once, so do I.

settled_muscle.speaker: Watch Sergeant
settled_muscle.text: Vermin out, Watch lock on, and someone else did the sweeping. If every dispute ended like this I'd die a happy sergeant. I won't. But noted.

settled_survey.speaker: Watch Sergeant
settled_survey.text: Trade-signs under our seal. Older claim, fair claim. ...Paperwork hates me. Fine — the Gnoll gets her cellar, the Watch gets a full sketch of that wall before a single shelf goes in. Precedent cuts both ways next time, and there is ALWAYS a next time.
